items.title: RTX's Raytheon completes installation of first SPY-6(V)4 array at Wallops Island test site
items.summary: WALLOPS ISLAND, Va., Aug. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Raytheon, an RTX (NYSE: RTX) business, has delivered and installed the first SPY-6(V)4 radar array at Surface Combat Systems Center at Wallops Island in Virginia, marking a major milestone for the U.S. Navy's Flight IIA Destroyer modernization effort and the SPY-6 backfit program. The Wallops site, a land‑based test facility situated over an open-water environment, will support extensive testing of the radar and its power and combat system interfaces ahead of installation on USS Pinckney (DDG 91), the first ship to be backfit with SPY‑6(V)4.SPY-6(V)4 is one of four variants in the SPY-6 family of radars, and is the only variant designed to backfit Flight IIA Destroyers. Initial testing will begin later this year and continue through mid‑2028.
